hooks.command: input=$(cat); log="${TEST_LAB_INTENDED_LOG:-/tmp/test-lab-intended.jsonl}"; name=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_name // "unknown"'); args=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -c '.tool_input // {}'); printf '{"ts":"%s","tool":"%s","args":%s}\n' "$(date -Iseconds)" "$name" "$args" >> "$log"; echo "DRY-RUN: $name blocked by test-lab hook.
